title: Count the pairs before guessing
hook: Pairs are plentiful. Their distance limit can be searched.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find a kth pair distance by counting pairs within a trial distance with two pointers.

misconception: Selecting a pair distance requires materializing every pair.
objective: Find a kth pair distance by counting pairs within a trial distance with two pointers.

claims.text: The window counts every pair whose distance fits the proposed limit. That count is monotone in the limit, so its first value reaching the requested rank identifies the answer even when distances tie.
